summaryZh: Bowman Lab 研究海洋、陆地及宿主微生物群落的结构与功能，以及微生物在地球系统中的作用。方法包括序列分析、流式细胞术和建模，主题涵盖极地微生物生态、宏基因组及生态系统功能。
researchQuestions: 微生物群落的结构和功能如何影响地球系统及生态系统服务？
topics: 微生物生态与生态系统功能

evidence.quote: The Bowman Lab is part of the Integrative Oceanography Division at Scripps Institution of Oceanography .

Our research explores many aspects of marine, terrestrial, and host microbial ecology. We use sequence based approaches, flow cytometry, modeling, and other techniques to explore the structure and function of microbial communities, and to understand the role of microbes in the Earth system.
Polar microbial ecology Astrobiology Metagenomics and metatranscriptomics Ecosystem modeling
